reasoning: This is a Phase I dose-escalation trial with a primary endpoint of maximum tolerated dose (MTD). Working through the causal chain: 1) TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker data available to confirm target engagement, but the trial successfully established an MTD of 200mg nintedanib, suggesting the drug was delivered at meaningful doses. 2) PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to assess downstream biology changes. 3) CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint (MTD) was successfully met - MTD was established at 200mg nintedanib across all dose levels tested. 4) POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5) CONFOUNDERS: This is a standard Phase I design focused on safety/tolerability rather than efficacy. The trial achieved its primary objective of establishing a recommended Phase II dose despite significant toxicity (63.2% Grade 3 AEs, 26.3% Grade 4 AEs). The success is defined by meeting the safety/tolerability endpoint, not by demonstrating clinical efficacy.
